items.item_text: Bachelor's Degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Minimum of 8-10 years of experience
Minimum of 5 years working in a healthcare environment.

Creates strategy, directs, plans, designs, develops, modifies, and deploys highly complex systems integration solutions that have broad, location-wide, institution-wide, and/or multi-institutional impact, engineering the most complex and advanced solutions to integrate vendor, community-source, and locally developed hardware and software systems and subsystems into a cohesive implementation. Translates clinical, administrative, and digital health business needs of the UCR School of Medicine and UCR Health into scalable, compliant technical architectures that achieve an integrated implementation. (25% time)

Directs or oversees analysis of potential products during early project phases to identify and achieve high level system integration objectives and determines/presents recommendations. Identifies, evaluates, determines and directs implementation changes to existing tools, or new tools needed, researches and/or coordinates with vendors to identify solutions. (25% time)

Incorporates advanced business processes knowledge in order to address technical objectives and address all phases of the business process and technical life-cycle. Use industry standards practices driving innovative solutions that are scalable for rapid growth to meet business needs. (15% time)

Provides configuration management support. Develops and/or oversees the build environment, the source code control system and the issue tracking systems. Oversees tests builds, resolves issues, and communicates build status. Oversees and/or directs building scripts and installation procedures and development and maintenance of an automated build process with automatic notification of build and unit test failure problems to responsible engineers. Oversees and/or directs project software and documentation inventory and configuration baselines. (15% time)

Oversees and/or develops highly complex monitoring protocols across multiple networks and platforms, including traffic and usage, performance of the system, metric testing, troubleshooting and identification of metric issues and system optimization for highly complex milti-platform environments. (10% time)

Provides guidance and expert knowledge of systems integration for EMR analysis, design, and operations and ensures security of data, systems, and networks that is used in our clinical operations environment. (10% time)
Read/Comprehend: Constantly
Write: Frequently
Perform Calculations: Occasionally

Experience with highly complex multi-platform troubleshooting in a multi-platform environment.
Experience with identification and use of code libraries and open-source forums.
Demonstrated ability to identify software and hardware interdependences in a highly complex multi-platform environment.
Experience developing and implementing complex/interdependent project plans.
Experience researching and evaluating new technology and solutions for the most complex environments.
Expert knowledge and experience with monitoring tools, performance, system optimization, including advanced knowledge of security for data, data transfers and systems.
Demonstrated ability to develop solutions for highly complex business and systems/custom/ad-hoc solutions.
Demonstrated ability to understand functional needs of the campus/medical center/UC system and how systems can support those needs.
Demonstrated ability to interface with all levels of technical and non-technical management on a regular basis.
Expert knowledge of systems integration deploying highly complex systems integration solutions.
Ability to impart knowledge to all levels of technical and non-technical audiences and to influence outcomes to meet objectives.
Experience with planning for deployment and creation of feedback mechanisms.
Expert skills associated with system integration design, modification, implementation and deployment for highly complex enviroments.
Demonstrated ability to develop highly complex conversion and system implementation plans.
Demonstrated ability to create software specfications.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strategy Development including roadmaps for key technologies
